headline: Findlay and Kentucky Wesleyan win on the road
dek: Findlay won at Thomas More and Kentucky Wesleyan at Cedarville on Saturday, each beating a side that had finished above them in the table. Both travel again on Thursday, Findlay to Tiffin and Kentucky Wesleyan to Lake Erie, and neither host has played since the table's last round.
displaced_by: Thomas More's outstanding match is played and lost at home to Findlay, so the standing dek's 'with a match still to play' is no longer true; Saturday's two away wins are the new story.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring is level across the upper half and falls away at the foot: Lake Erie's 36 are more than Northwood and Ohio Dominican have scored together.

wire.line: Lake Erie have won every conference match since their draw at Tiffin, and no one can now catch them.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Tiffin have drawn six matches, more than any other programme in the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Nick Cherry has kept nine clean sheets for Tiffin.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Ohio Dominican have won one match all season, drawn five and lost eleven.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Tom Woodward has scored twelve goals for Ashland from 70 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Jersey Lopez has fourteen assists for Kentucky Wesleyan.

last_match.line: Kentucky Wesleyan have won both their visits to Cedarville this season.

next_match.line: Lake Erie won at Kentucky Wesleyan in September, the only time the sides have met this season.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
